hooks.command: f="$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH"; case "$f" in *"/frontend/apps/vue-app/src/"*|*"/frontend/apps/vue-app/src"*) (cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/frontend/apps/vue-app" && pnpm exec prettier --write --log-level=error "$f" 2>&1 | tail -5) ;; *"/frontend/apps/react-app/src/"*|*"/frontend/apps/react-app/src"*) (cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/frontend/apps/react-app" && pnpm exec prettier --write --log-level=error "$f" 2>&1 | tail -5) ;; *"/frontend/packages/"*"/src/"*|*"/frontend/packages/"*"/src"*) (cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/frontend" && pnpm exec prettier --write --log-level=error "$f" 2>&1 | tail -5) ;; esac

f="$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH"; case "$f" in *"/frontend/apps/vue-app/src/"*|*"/frontend/apps/vue-app/src"*) (cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/frontend/apps/vue-app" && pnpm exec oxlint "$f" 2>&1 | tail -10) ;; *"/frontend/apps/react-app/src/"*|*"/frontend/apps/react-app/src"*) (cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/frontend/apps/react-app" && pnpm exec oxlint "$f" 2>&1 | tail -10) ;; esac

f="$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH"; case "$f" in *.py) (cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/backend" && uv run --with ruff ruff format --quiet "$f" 2>&1; uv run --with ruff ruff check --no-fix "$f" 2>&1 | tail -10) ;; *.go) gofmt -w "$f" 2>&1; go vet "$f" 2>&1 | head -10 ;; esac
